_om: Telleren in English (Tally, rusj.no/en/tally/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The rules on the board are in data.en/regler.json. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Ingen regler ennå. Den som sier 21, lage: No rules yet. Whoever says 21 makes the first one.
Dere teller i ring fra 1 til 21. Den som: You count round the circle from 1 to 21. Whoever has to say 21 takes a small sip and puts a new rule on a number. The rules pile up – and the counting gets harder.
Den som begynner, sier 1. Hver sier ett,: The starter says 1. Each person says one, two or three numbers in a row, then it passes to the next.
tar en liten slurk og lager en regel – f: takes a small sip and makes a rule – for example ‘say banana instead of 7’. The phone suggests three, or you write your own.
Glemmer noen en regel eller sier feil, t: If someone forgets a rule or says the wrong thing, they take a sip and you start again from 1.
Alkoholfritt teller like mye, og alle ka: Alcohol-free counts just as much, and anyone can sit a round out – no explanation needed.
Trykk på et tall på tavla for å se regel: Tap a number on the board to see its rule.
Etter hver fjerde regel tar alle en vann: After every fourth rule, everyone has a water break.
Spis og drikk vann underveis, og sørg fo: Eat and drink water as you go, and make sure everyone gets home safely.
